messages.content: You are a software repairer. Use exactly one bash tool per response.

Fix the original issue: # split_after emits an unexpected empty trailing group

The public split_after function behaves inconsistently when maxsplit is reached
at the final element of the input:

```python
from more_itertools import split_after
list(split_after([1], lambda x: x == 1))              # [[1]]
list(split_after([1], lambda x: x == 1, maxsplit=2))  # [[1]]
list(split_after([1], lambda x: x == 1, maxsplit=1))  # currently [[1], []]
```

The last result should also be [[1]]. Do not emit an empty trailing group when
the split limit is reached and there are no remaining elements. Preserve a
nonempty remainder, iterator inputs, unlimited splitting, and maxsplit=0
behavior. Fix the implementation and run the supplied checks and existing tests.

Work only in this checkout; no parent files, web, installs or deletion. Do not edit TASK.md, tests, task_checks or metadata. Only change existing implementation files. Put helpers in temp/. Use exactly one bash call per response, short line reads, then reproduce, repair and validate. Fresh Git Bash runs each command. Run both:
python -B -m unittest tests.test_more.SplitAfterTest -v
python -B -m unittest discover -s task_checks -v
When done, execute echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT by itself.
